DASH SASANKA S

Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner Ph No.: +91 8073994230 sasanka.dash96@gmail.com

Professional Summary

Trusted partner with profound 9 years of experience in driving enterprise-scale digital transformations across Payments, Banking, FinTech, and Audit platforms, converting complex stakeholder needs into high-adoption, measurable business outcomes.

Education MBA - WX - Strategic Leadership & Marketing NMIMS - Mumbai - 03/2024

B.Tech - Electrical Engineering ITER- SOA University - Bhubaneswar - 05/2016

Core Competencies

Business Analysis

and Requirements Analysis

Governance Gathering Stakeholder Management

&

Scope defining and MVP Planning Backlog Prioritization & Value Delivery Agile, SAFe Agile & Hybrid delivery model

Generative AI - RAG, Agentic AI

BPMN, UML

GAP Analysis, Risk & Change Impact Management UI/ UX Collaboration, Vibe Prototyping Consulting, Sales and Pre Sales - RFP, RFI, RFQ

Skills

Methodologies & Frameworks: Agile, SAFe,

Waterfall, Hybrid (SDLC)

Business Analysis: Requirement Elicitation, Requirement Definition, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, BRD,

FRD, SRS, UAT Coordination, Gap Analysis, User Story Mapping, Data Analysis (SQL, Excel), RTM, RACI Matrix, RCA, Customer Journey Design (BABOK V3)

Project Management Tools: Microsoft Azure DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, Trello, Excel, Redmine Modelling & Visualization: Visio, Draw.io, Mindmaps, Miro, Canva, Lucidchart, Whimsical (UML/BPMN 2.0 ) UX Tools: Balsamiq, Figma, Justinmind, Adobe XD, Sketch, InVision Sales, Pre-Sales, and Production Support: SAP CRM, Salesforce, Leadsquared, ServiceNow UAT: Postman, TestRail

Certifications

Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) by Scrum Alliance

Work History

Lead Business Analyst, 2023 to Current Happiest Minds Technologies Limited - Bengaluru, KA Projects - Deloitte’s Levvia-Global Content Management System, AI Chatbot implementation on Levvia

Owned the complete Levvia SME Auditing tool’s Digital transformation, driving a 25% rise in adoption. Drove 100+ stakeholder interviews and 70+ workshops across 5 teams, reducing misalignment by 30%. Owned a backlog of 40+ features in MS Azure DevOps across multiple Agile PODs, minimizing dependency and reducing sprint bottlenecks by 25%. Proposed an AI Tool to convert Figma designs into Flutter code, reducing front-end development effort by 60%. Designed wireframes and mockups in Figma and Balsamiq, efficiently reducing design iterations by 20%.

Acted as a proxy product owner and scrum master, boosting team velocity by 15% and slashing sprint delays by 25%. Translated evolving business requirements into 40+ BRDs and 600+ user stories, wireframes, and process flows, trimming rework by 30% and streamlining delivery. Facilitated PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Reviews, and retrospectives for 3 products. Supported UAT, achieving 95% defect resolution and rapid stakeholder sign-off.

Senior Business Analyst, 2022 to 2023 Ernst & Young -Global Delivery Services - Bengaluru, KA Projects - NCR Voyix’s Digital Transformation

Contributed to the development of white papers, technical documents, and other project-related documentation, and presented findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders. Conducted in-depth qualitative and quantitative research to identify trends and generate insights. Conducted 80+ requirement workshops with product, design, and dev teams, delivering specs that ensured on-time launches. Crafted wireframes and mockups in JustInMind and Adobe XD, reducing design iteration cycles by 30% Collaborated with cross-functional teams for a holistic approach to research initiatives, achieving an increase of 40% in thought leadership engagement. Accountable for UAT and regression testing for more than a dozen products, reaching 95% first-pass acceptance and reducing post-release bugs 40% Coordinated test plans, triaged defects, and demoed features to business units across the US, EMEA, APAC, and EU Clients, accelerating fixes by 35%. Mentored five new junior Business Analysts, halving onboarding time and embedding consistent Agile practices

Assistant Manager, 2021 to 2022 PayU Payments- Bengaluru, KA Projects - Production Support Digital Transformation

Owned Solution Design Workshops with Business and Development teams. Authored well-formed user stories and tasks in Jira with a clear Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and acceptance criteria. Designed a customer complaint and dispute management workflow, aligning with collections, customer servicing, achieving a 30% uplift in customer satisfaction.

Assistant Manager, 2019 to 2021

Paytm Payments Bank- Bengaluru, KA

Projects - Enterprise Payment Solutions - Payouts, VAN

Worked on retail banking operations including payment monitoring, exception handling, and customer servicing workflows, collaborating with business and technology teams to identify risk scenarios, transaction failures, and dispute resolution processes. Partnered across teams to scope features and plan the roadmap in line with strategic objectives. Worked closely with clients to understand the project vision and translate that into a business requirement for the team. Assisted the Product Manager with detailed use cases and structured project plans to guide execution.

Senior Associate, 2017 to 2019 BYJU’S - Bengaluru, KA Projects - Byju’s EasyPay Platform

Accountable for IT integration across two business mergers, coordinating dependencies, cutover, and stabilization. Created UML Use Case, Sequence, and Activity diagrams with Enterprise Architect to capture system design.

Relationship Manager, 2016 to 2017 Thinktel Solutions Pvt ltd - Bengaluru, KA Projects - UNICEF India’s customer acquisition Web page

Collaborated with stakeholder groups across the organization to ensure business and technology alignment. Proposed solutions meeting defined specifications and needs. Accountable for maintenance and improvement of the platform, following continuous discovery practices.Awards &

Recognitions

i-Appreciate | Happiest Minds I’m Exceptional and Kudos Award | EY-GDS

Rockstar Performer | Paytm Employee of the Year | ThinkTel
